## New
- Pinch the mini player to any size between Small and full width; it gives a little past either end
- Drag the tab of a tucked mini player to pull it back out with your finger
- The mini player shows a close mark when letting go will close it
- TalkBack actions on the mini player: open, close, make larger or smaller, move to the next corner, tuck away

## Improved
- The tuck tab slides in as the mini player leaves the screen, and swipes on it no longer trigger Back
